item.title: Lutcher man sentenced to 25 years following 2020 officer-involved shooting
item.description: LUTCHER &mdash; A Lutcher man was sentenced to 25 years following a 2020 officer-involved shooting in St. James Parish.&nbsp;According to Louisiana State Police, two deputies with the St. James Parish Sheriff's Office were surveying 41-year-old Edward Young III for illegal drug activity when Young allegedly approached the detectives, holding a handgun.After the detectives identified themselves, Young allegedly ran through a residential neighborhood while firing multiple shots at the detectives.

item.title: Deputies ask for help identifying alleged Dollar General thieves in Port Allen
item.description: PORT ALLEN &mdash; Deputies have asked for the public's help in identifying several people accused of stealing from a Dollar General in Port Allen.&nbsp;According to the West Baton Rouge Sheriff's Office, the alleged thieves stole multiple items from the store on Jan. 11 before leaving in a four-door Nissan sedan.&nbsp;Anyone with information about the suspects' identities can call WBRSO at 225-382-5200 or 225-343-9234.Permalink| Comments

item.title: 2 Make a Difference: Woman who worked with St. Vincent de Paul retires after decade of service
